messages:
sarah-m: quick sync after the RFC 

I sketched a minimal delta surface between hosted/dedicated/private. want to align on three hot areas: auth translation, observability handoff, and routing/fallback semantics.

mike-l: sounds good. paste the sketch here please, bullets ok.

sarah-m: bullets: 1) auth: hosted uses our token mapping; private must support customer KMS-backed tokens and an auth-adapter that returns a canonical tenant id. 2) observability: traces must carry tenant id but redact secrets; private may export to customer OTEL endpoints when configured. 3) fallback: control plane should allow routing to lower-tier variant (dedicated/hosted) without API changes.

raj-p: +1 but worried about token-translation complexity and key rollover. also how do we prevent double-counting in billing when fallback happens?

linh: for token translation propose a tiny contract: translate(token) -> tenant_id | error. keep it sync and fast. adapters must implement key rollover support and edge caching.

mike-l: fallback state machine idea: prefer private by default, wait for latency_ms or error_threshold, then failover to dedicated. two-phase: transient fast failover client-side after X ms, sustained control-plane re-route after N failures in W seconds.

sarah-m: suggested manifest snippet (proto-like):

```
hosting:
  policy:
    prefer: private
    failover:
      latency_ms: 200
      error_threshold: 5
      sustained_window_secs: 30
    privacy_mode: redact
```

sarah-m: manifest changes must be additive; agents should ignore unknown fields.

raj-p: billing: we tag tokens with route-id and final-exec-variant. control plane must emit an event when failover occurs so billing can decide chargeback.

linh: observability edge: if private refuses export we should fall back to "redact-and-forward" minimal metrics to control plane (counts, latency histograms). add privacy_mode = \"redact\" in manifest.

mike-l: runtime hints (quantization, batch size) should be control-plane-only serve-hints. not surfaced to customer manifests. agent ignores serve-hints.

raj-p: rotation note: adapter should accept staged key list in manifest and validate via KMS. plan: adapters watch KMS versions and rotate with overlap window. document rotation flow.

linh: test matrix: hosted->private failover, private->dedicated cold start, unknown manifest fields, sample export blocked. add automated harness scenarios in the local shim testbed.

mike-l: next steps: sarah to PR manifest + adapter contract, raj drafts rotation flow, linh owns harness scenarios, i'll draft routing state machine and probe thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy check: no CI changes required for this thread.

sarah-m: thanks all 44d 
I'll drop the PR and RFC follow-up and ping for reviews.
